sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.

sentences.en: Today, an inside look at how President Trump is thinking about the war in Iran, the stalled negotiations to end it,
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将深入探讨特朗普总统如何看待对伊朗的战争、结束战争的陷入僵局的谈判，

sentences.en: and the political fallout for his party as it heads into the midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 以及在其党派即将迎来中期选举之际面临的政治余波。

sentences.en: I spoke with White House reporters Maggie Haberman and Jonathan Swan.
sentences.zh: 我采访了白宫记者玛吉·哈伯曼和乔纳森·斯旺。

sentences.en: It's Friday, April 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月24日，星期五。

sentences.en: Maggie and Jonathan, welcome back.
sentences.zh: 玛吉和乔纳森，欢迎回归。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: It's good to be back.
sentences.zh: 很高兴回来。

sentences.en: It's really good to have you back.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你们能回来。

sentences.en: And this is a really bigger than usual welcome back because, just to explain, you have both been on leave for a few months,
sentences.zh: 这次欢迎回归的规格比平时要大得多，因为简单解释一下，你们俩都请了几个月的假，

sentences.en: a joint leave you left together because you've been writing a book together about President Trump's second term.
sentences.zh: 这是一次联合休假，你们一起离开是因为你们一直在合写一本关于特朗普总统第二任期的书。

sentences.en: And while we profoundly missed you as guests on the show when you were on this leave, we are now the beneficiaries of all this reporting that you did for the book
sentences.zh: 虽然在你们休假期间，我们非常想念你们作为节目的嘉宾，但我们现在成了你们为这本书所做的大量报道

sentences.en: and the insights that you gleaned.
sentences.zh: 以及你们收集到的深刻见解的受益者。

sentences.en: And what we want to talk to you about specifically is what you've uncovered in your reporting about how the president has been making decisions in the second term,
sentences.zh: 我们想具体和你们聊聊的，是你们在报道中发现的关于总统在第二任期内是如何做出决策的，

sentences.en: his mindset, his process on a variety of fronts, but most specifically, most urgently around Iran.
sentences.zh: 他的心态，他在各个战线上的决策过程，但最具体、最紧迫的还是围绕伊朗的问题。

sentences.en: So let us start there.
sentences.zh: 那我们就从这里开始吧。

sentences.en: We're at a really key moment when the original ceasefire has ended.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于一个非常关键的时刻，最初的停火已经结束。

sentences.en: New talks are being offered by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国提出了新的会谈，

sentences.en: but kind of rejected by Iran.
sentences.zh: 但基本上被伊朗拒绝了。

sentences.en: John, how is the president approaching these peace talks, which on the surface look very precarious?
sentences.zh: 约翰，总统是如何看待这些表面上看起来非常危险的和平谈判的？

sentences.en: Well, so we're recording this Thursday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以我们是在周四下午录制这期节目的。

sentences.en: And the reason I timestamp it is because it's a very fluid situation.
sentences.zh: 我加上时间戳是因为这是一个非常多变的情况。

sentences.en: But as of now, as of this moment, the Trump team is still waiting on a response from the Iranians to a proposal that was sent over to them,
sentences.zh: 但截至目前，截至这一刻，特朗普团队仍在等待伊朗人对一份发给他们的提案做出回应，

sentences.en: which outlined broad deal points, baseline points to start a negotiation, to start a more serious and detailed negotiation,
sentences.zh: 该提案概述了广泛的协议要点、开始谈判的基准点，以开启更严肃、更详细的谈判，

sentences.en: mostly focused on how do we prevent Iran from getting a nuclear weapon and how do we get the highly enriched uranium out of Iran?
sentences.zh: 主要集中在如何阻止伊朗获得核武器，以及如何将高浓缩铀运出伊朗？

sentences.en: Those are the two main issues involved.
sentences.zh: 这是涉及的两个主要问题。

sentences.en: And Trump is very frustrated right now because nobody on his team, you know, you've got J.D.
sentences.zh: 特朗普现在非常沮丧，因为他团队里的任何人，你知道，副总统万斯，

sentences.en: Vance, the vice president, you've got Jared Kushner, his son-in-law, you've got Steve Witkoff,
sentences.zh: 他的女婿杰瑞德·库什纳，他的特使史蒂夫·维特考夫，

sentences.en: his special envoy, dealing with the Iranians through the Pakistanis as an intermediary.
sentences.zh: 都在通过巴基斯坦人作为中间人与伊朗人打交道。

sentences.en: And it's very frustrating to Trump because he doesn't feel he can negotiate properly with the Iranians.
sentences.zh: 这让特朗普非常沮丧，因为他觉得自己无法与伊朗人进行适当的谈判。

sentences.en: It's not clear that the Iranian negotiators are empowered to negotiate.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚伊朗谈判代表是否获得授权进行谈判。

sentences.en: It's very unclear the extent to which they're able to communicate in real time with the Ayatollah, who we don't have a clear idea of his health, his well-being.
sentences.zh: 目前很不清楚他们在多大程度上能够与阿亚图拉进行实时沟通，对于阿亚图拉的健康和状况，我们并没有清晰的概念。

sentences.en: It seems pretty clear that he's in a bad way and that the negotiators are not able to get quick responsiveness from him.
sentences.zh: 很明显，他的情况不太好，谈判代表无法从他那里得到快速的响应。

sentences.en: So you're getting a lot of mixed messages, a lot of silence.
sentences.zh: 所以你得到了很多混乱的信息，很多沉默。

sentences.en: And so we're in this very uncertain moment.
sentences.zh: 因此我们正处于这个非常不确定的时刻。

sentences.en: Trump has extended this ceasefire seemingly indefinitely.
sentences.zh: 特朗普似乎无限期地延长了这次停火。

sentences.en: But at the same time, they've kept enormous military force in the Middle East and are poised to attack if this thing falls apart.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他们在从中东撤出庞大军事力量的同时，也随时准备在局势崩溃时发起攻击。

sentences.en: The other frustration for Trump is he's facing real constraints.
sentences.zh: 对特朗普来说，另一个沮丧之处在于他面临着现实的制约。

sentences.en: You know, despite all the bravado that you hear from the president and from Pete Hegsef, the secretary of defense,
sentences.zh: 你知道，尽管你听到总统和国防部长皮特·海格塞斯吹嘘说，

sentences.en: you know, we have unlimited weapons, et cetera, et cetera, that they don't have unlimited weapons.
sentences.zh: 我们有无限的武器，诸如此类，但他们实际上并没有无限的武器。

sentences.en: And they're very, very constrained when it comes to long range strike weapons.
sentences.zh: 当涉及到远程打击武器时，他们受到了非常非常大的限制。

sentences.en: So what that means is if they do do what Trump has threatened, which is, you know, blow up every bridge and power plant inside Iran,
sentences.zh: 这意味着，如果他们真的做了特朗普所威胁的事情，也就是，炸毁伊朗境内的每一座桥梁和发电厂，

sentences.en: they don't really have the long range arsenal to do that.
sentences.zh: 他们其实并没有那样做的远程军火库。

sentences.en: So that means flying planes in, exposing your pilots to risk, potentially having...
sentences.zh: 这意味着派遣飞机进入，让你的飞行员面临风险，潜在地拥有……

sentences.en: Once again.
sentences.zh: 再次。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Potentially having more shootdowns.
sentences.zh: 可能会有更多的飞机被击落。

sentences.en: And Trump has shown great appetite for risk during his presidency.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在他的总统任期内表现出对风险的巨大胃口。

sentences.en: But when it comes to U.S.
sentences.zh: 但当涉及到美国人伤亡，

sentences.en: casualties, service member casualties, that's not an area where he's willing to push it.
sentences.zh: 军人伤亡时，那不是他愿意推进一步的领域。

sentences.en: So that's the real tension here.
sentences.zh: 所以真正的紧张局势在这里。

sentences.en: And, you know, Maggie and I talk about this all the time in our reporting.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，玛吉和我在报道中经常谈论这一点。

sentences.en: He underestimated the Iranians.
sentences.zh: 他低估了伊朗人。

sentences.en: He thought this would be a fast war, that they would capitulate.
sentences.zh: 他以为这是一场速战速决的战争，他们会投降。

sentences.en: He did not expect the staying power that they've shown and their ability to disrupt global commerce, even as the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他没有料到他们表现出的持久力以及他们破坏全球商业的能力，尽管美国

sentences.en: and Israel have just been pounding them with these bombing campaigns.
sentences.zh: 和以色列一直在用这些轰炸行动痛击他们。

sentences.en: So just to be very clear, what's frustrating for Trump is that on the one hand, he can't tell for sure that the Iranians are really negotiating in good faith,
sentences.zh: 所以必须非常明确的是，让特朗普感到沮丧的是，一方面，他无法确定伊朗人是否真的在真诚地谈判，

sentences.en: that they have a system that's timely for getting word from the Ayatollah that they can do this kind of deal or that kind of deal.
sentences.zh: 他们是否有能够及时从阿亚图拉那里获得消息的系统来达成这种或那种协议。

sentences.en: And on the other hand, the United States is not necessarily capable of expeditiously doing what it might need to do to force the Iranians to sign on to some sort of a peace deal.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，美国不一定有能力迅速采取可能需要采取的行动，迫使伊朗人签署某种和平协议。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And the ball is really in Iran's court right now.
sentences.zh: 现在球确实在伊朗这边。

sentences.en: And it's not necessarily by design.
sentences.zh: 这不一定是刻意安排的。

sentences.en: It is also because of fractures within their own structure.
sentences.zh: 这也是因为他们自身结构内部的裂痕。

sentences.en: But that is where it is.
sentences.zh: 但现状就是这样。

sentences.en: And it is outside of his control.
sentences.zh: 这超出了他的控制范围。

sentences.en: And they are essentially in a holding pattern in the White House until they hear something back.
sentences.zh: 在听到任何消息之前，白宫的他们基本上处于待命状态。

sentences.en: Which would be frustrating.
sentences.zh: 这会令人沮丧。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Especially because the president has made very clear he would like this to move on faSt.
sentences.zh: 特别是考虑到总统已经明确表示他希望这件事能快点推进。

sentences.en: Now, he just wants this to be done.
sentences.zh: 现在，他只是希望这一切结束。

sentences.en: He wants this to be done.
sentences.zh: 他希望这一切结束。

sentences.en: And he wants to move on to other things.
sentences.zh: 他想继续处理其他事情。

sentences.en: And he wants to talk about different subjects.
sentences.zh: 他想谈论不同的话题。

sentences.en: This is out of his control.
sentences.zh: 这超出了他的控制。

sentences.en: And he is somebody who prizes control of his environment.
sentences.zh: 而他是一个珍视对自己环境控制的人。

sentences.en: People in his orbit in the White House, some of them anyway, are much clearer eyed that there were going to be several days of waiting here.
sentences.zh: 他白宫核心圈子里的人，至少其中一些人，要清醒得多，知道这里会有几天的等待。

sentences.en: On the other hand, they've also been pretty clear, some of them anyway, that whatever came back, if they got something back that they considered halfway decent as a response,
sentences.zh: 另一方面，他们也相当明确，至少其中一些人认为，无论带回什么，如果他们带回了一个他们认为还算像样的回应，

sentences.en: they would like to move forward.
sentences.zh: 他们希望继续推进。

sentences.en: Because, again, to go back to the point, the president would like to be done with this.
sentences.zh: 因为，再次回到那个观点，总统希望这件事能赶紧结束。

sentences.en: One of the other issues is, you know, you use the phrase good faith.
sentences.zh: 另一个问题是，你知道，你用了“诚意”这个词。

sentences.en: Well, the fact is, from the Iranian perspective, they've been in two rounds of negotiations with the United States and have been bombed during both times.
sentences.zh: 事实上，从伊朗的角度来看，他们已经与美国进行了两轮谈判，并且在这两次谈判期间都遭到了轰炸。

sentences.en: So there's not a huge amount of trust going on when your leadership keeps getting killed when you're in conversation.
sentences.zh: 所以，当你的领导层在对话时不断被杀害时，根本谈不上有多大的信任。

sentences.en: So there is no trust here.
sentences.zh: 所以这里没有信任可言。

sentences.en: And the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而且美国

sentences.en: has wiped out.
sentences.zh: 已经消灭了……

sentences.en: You know, Trump himself said, we had a few people in mind that could have maybe taken over, but we killed them.
sentences.zh: 你知道，特朗普自己说过，我们脑海里有几个人选可能可以接管，但我们把他们干掉了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: The issue is, when you haven't actually established a very clear objective, or the objectives have shifted, when Trump has sometimes said, Iranians, rise up, it's regime change.
sentences.zh: 问题是，当你实际上没有确立一个非常明确的目标，或者目标已经改变时，当特朗普有时说，伊朗人，站起来吧，这是政权更迭。

sentences.en: Well, in a certain sense, it is regime change because the Aitola was killed.
sentences.zh: 好吧，从某种意义上说，这确实是政权更迭，因为阿亚图拉被干掉了。

sentences.en: It might actually be a more hardline regime.
sentences.zh: 这实际上可能是一个更强硬的政权。

sentences.en: So it's very, very complicated.
sentences.zh: 所以情况非常非常复杂。

sentences.en: And everyone on Trump's team understands that.
sentences.zh: 特朗普团队中的每个人都明白这一点。

sentences.en: Trump is someone who is used to authoring his own reality, declaring reality, bending events, bending people's minds through force of will, force of personality.
sentences.zh: 特朗普是一个习惯于创造自己的现实、宣示现实、扭曲事件、通过意志力和个性力量扭曲人们思想的人。

sentences.en: And there are certain events that have happened during his presidencies that have defied that ability.
sentences.zh: 而在他的总统任期内发生了一些事件，是对这种能力的一种挑战。

sentences.en: COVID was a big one, and this war is a big one.
sentences.zh: 新冠疫情是一场大危机，这场战争也是一场大危机。

sentences.en: Iran gets a big vote in what happens next.
sentences.zh: 对于接下来发生什么，伊朗有很大的投票权。

sentences.en: It's not something that Donald Trump can unilaterally define and determine.
sentences.zh: 这不是唐纳德·特朗普能够单方面定义和决定的事情。

sentences.en: You just said that Trump's team understood just how complicated this war could be.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说特朗普的团队明白这场战争会有多复杂。

sentences.en: And I think it's worth going back to how it all began.
sentences.zh: 我认为有必要回顾一下这一切是如何开始的。

sentences.en: We've done that before on the show, just to be clear.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目中以前也这样做过，澄清一下。

sentences.en: But you both put a particular focus in your reporting on the origins of this war.
sentences.zh: 但你们两个在报道中特别关注了这场战争的起源。

sentences.en: And I wonder how you've come to think about how those origins frame and influence how the president now views this moment when, in theory, it could be coming to an end,
sentences.zh: 我想知道你们是如何看待这些起源如何塑造和影响总统现在如何看待这个时刻的——在理论上，它可能就要结束了，

sentences.en: but it's coming to an end in this complicated fashion.
sentences.zh: 但它却以这种复杂的方式走向结束。

sentences.en: I'd phrase it slightly differently, Michael, or frame it slightly differently.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我会换个说法，或者换个角度来表达。

sentences.en: I don't think that how they came to this war has fundamentally shifted how Trump is looking at this particular moment.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他们是如何走到这场战争这一步的，从根本上改变了特朗普看待这个特定时刻的方式。

sentences.en: I actually think it's very consistent, which is Trump has always been more consistently hardline on Iran than his own team.
sentences.zh: 我实际上认为这非常一致，也就是说特朗普对伊朗的态度一直比他自己的团队更一致地强硬。

sentences.en: And certainly than a lot of his supporters wanted to believe he was.
sentences.zh: 当然也比他的许多支持者希望相信的要强硬。

sentences.en: Wanted to believe he was.
sentences.zh: 希望相信他曾经是那样。

sentences.en: And to be fair to them, he said things that suggested that he was far more dovish than he actually is, at least, you know, generally speaking, but certainly in terms of Iran.
sentences.zh: 为了对他们公平起见，他说过的话表明他比实际表现出来的要温和得多，至少，你知道，总体而言，但在伊朗问题上绝对是这样。

sentences.en: He did pull back strikes in 2019 against Iran because he was warned of casualty numbers at the last minute.
sentences.zh: 2019年他确实取消了对伊朗的打击，因为他在最后一刻收到了伤亡人数的警告。

sentences.en: And it was much to the chagrin of John.
sentences.zh: 这让约翰非常懊恼。

sentences.en: This is in his first time.
sentences.zh: 这是在他的第一个任期内。

sentences.en: His first term, national security advisor, which, you know, added to why people thought, ah, see, he's against the Hawks.
sentences.zh: 他的第一任国家安全顾问，你知道，这增加了为什么人们会想，啊，你看，他是反对鹰派的。

sentences.en: And then he authorized the strike against General Soleimani very early in 2020, which was a definitional moment for him.
sentences.zh: 然后在2020年初，他授权对苏莱曼尼将军进行打击，这对他的具有定义性的时刻。

sentences.en: It is also part of why the Iranians had been looking to have a strike on Trump and on some people around him for many years after that.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么在那之后的许多年里，伊朗人一直想要对特朗普以及他身边的一些人进行打击的部分原因。

sentences.en: That was a strike that a lot of his own advisors were concerned about him taking.
sentences.zh: 那次打击让他的许多顾问都担心他会采取。

sentences.en: And so he has always marched more consistently against Iran.
sentences.zh: 所以他针对伊朗的立场一直更加坚定。

sentences.en: And it is something that it does hearken back to, you know, sort of his formative years, not putting him on the couch, but just being clear about something he's talked about,
sentences.zh: 这确实让人回想起，你知道，可以说是他形成观点的岁月，不是在做心理分析，只是明确一件事，他谈论过，

sentences.en: actually fairly consistently, is Iran, especially the 1979 hostage crisis, especially how harmful it was to Jimmy Carter's presidency,
sentences.zh: 而且相当一致，那就是伊朗，特别是1979年人质危机，特别是它对吉米·卡特总统任期造成了多大的破坏，

sentences.en: which was one of the first that Trump really paid close attention to as an adult.
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普成年后真正密切关注的事件之一。

sentences.en: As deep as it gets, yes, but also the fact that it had been many years now of Iran personally threatening him, which is something that he actually said as almost, I think,

sentences.en: Right.

sentences.en: And just to summarize what the JCPOA does, because I was prepared for this conversation—
sentences.zh: 为了总结一下伊核协议的内容，因为我为这次谈话做了准备——

sentences.en: Thank you.

sentences.zh: 并且涉及取消对伊朗实施了很久的一些制裁。

sentences.en: But it foresaw a, I think, 15-year period where Iran would make no progress toward becoming nuclear.
sentences.zh: 但它预见了一个，我认为是15年的期限，在此期间伊朗在成为核国家方面不会有任何进展。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Or obtaining a nuclear weapon, to be more specific.
sentences.zh: 或者说得更具体一点，是获取核武器。

sentences.en: And there is a difference between civil enrichment and weaponized weapons.
sentences.zh: 民用浓缩和武器化之间是有区别的。

sentences.zh: 它一直是共和党人关注的焦点。

sentences.zh: 如果你看看过去十年全国各地的共和党初选讨论，伊核协议一直是不断被提及的老调。

sentences.en: And it was often talked about by Donald Trump, candidate then president.

sentences.en: And so one of the first things he did was tear this deal up.
sentences.zh: 因此，他做的第一件事就是撕毁了这项协议。

sentences.zh: 他对此感到非常骄傲。

sentences.en: He has talked about it constantly, and he has talked about why he thought it was a very bad deal.
sentences.zh: 他经常谈到这一点，并谈到了他为什么认为这是一笔非常糟糕的交易。

sentences.en: And throughout these conversations that Steve Witkoff, his main Mideast envoy—but I interlocked her, for lack of a better way of putting it, except for his son-in-law,

sentences.zh: 贾里德·库什纳——但在过去一年里，威特科夫才是与伊朗人（或者至少是中间人）进行这些会谈时在房间里的人。

sentences.en: And there were various points where the levels, at least at one point publicly, were going to be the same as what was in the JCPOA.
sentences.zh: 在某些节点上，至少在公开的一个时间点，各层级的内容将与伊核协议中的内容相同。

sentences.en: And that caused all kinds of alarms for Republicans on Capitol Hill and for people close to the White House.
sentences.zh: 这引起了国会山共和党人以及白宫核心人士的各种警惕。

sentences.en: And so that's what the president knows he wants to avoid.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是总统深知自已想要避免的事情。

sentences.zh: 乔纳森，有没有一种非常现实的可能性：特朗普从伊朗能得到的最好协议——他可能并不喜欢，

sentences.en: but it's just maybe all he's going to get—is a deal that's going to look a heck of a lot like the deal he hates that Obama got?
sentences.zh: 但可能也就是他仅能得到的全部——其实是一个极像他所痛恨的奥巴马当年达成的协议？

sentences.en: Yeah, there's definitely a risk of that.
sentences.zh: 是的，这绝对是有风险的。

sentences.en: There are two areas where he wants to distinguish himself from Obama.
sentences.zh: 他有两个地方想要把自己和奥巴马区分开来。

sentences.en: The sunsets—when does this deal expire?
sentences.zh: 日落条款——这项协议什么时候到期？

sentences.zh: 伊朗浓缩铀能力的限制何时解除？

sentences.zh: 另一个是特朗普对奥巴马耿耿于怀的所谓“一托盘一托盘的现金”。

sentences.en: Part of the Iran deal that Obama struck with Iran involved releasing large sums of cash to the Iranian regime.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马与伊朗达成的伊核协议的一部分，涉及向伊朗政权释放巨额现金。

sentences.en: And it came, in some cases, in the form of physical cash.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，它是以实物现金的形式提供的。

sentences.zh: 这确实深深触动了特朗普的想象力。

sentences.en: It's something that he's talked about aggressively on the campaign trail.
sentences.zh: 这是他在竞选集会上激烈谈论过的事情。

sentences.en: And it's something that he wants to avoid himself having to do with Iran.
sentences.zh: 这也是他希望自已在处理伊朗问题时避免去做的事情。

sentences.en: So that's a big red line for him.
sentences.zh: 所以这对他是条巨大的红线。

sentences.en: But they're going to have to give a little because they didn't have a complete victory in this war.

sentences.zh: 在伊核协议中送出的东西更胜一筹？

sentences.zh: 彻底消灭该项目，并迎进一个对美国更友好的新政权。

sentences.zh: 但目前这些看起来都不太可能。

sentences.zh: 所以他们正在寻找在这两个领域可以做些什么，能被视为比奥巴马设法做到的要好。

sentences.en: And they might be on the margins.
sentences.zh: 而这些可能只是边角余料。

sentences.zh: 嗯，这不仅可能只是边角余料，现实情况是，随着我们越来越接近中期选举周期，

sentences.zh: 紧接着又是由于特朗普受任期限制而将产生一个空缺席位、人们将争相接替他的总统选举周期，

sentences.zh: 你会看到越来越多的共和党参议员想要寻求与这个白宫保持一些距离。

sentences.zh: 我认为如果有人试图基本上，你知道的，粉饰一个版本的伊核协议，你会看到更多的人站出来批评。

sentences.zh: 他甚至亲自决定去侮辱天主教会的领袖——教皇。

sentences.en: Why does Trump not seem to care in this moment about the political risks that all of these pose?
sentences.zh: 为什么此时此刻特朗普似乎并不在意这一切带来的政治风险？

sentences.en: Or does he care?
sentences.zh: 还是说他在意？

sentences.en: Jonathan points often to something that Trump said about some—I think it was a special election or about another election cycle,
sentences.zh: 乔纳森经常提到特朗普曾经说过的话——我想那是关于一场特别选举，或者是关于另一个选举周期，

sentences.en: maybe last year, that he was very honored that Republicans didn't do well when his name wasn't on the ballot, because that is generally how he looks at it.
sentences.zh: 也许是去年，当他的名字不在选票上时共和党人表现不好，他对此感到非常荣幸，因为他通常就是这么看的。

sentences.en: He's not on the ballot, and so, therefore, this isn't really about him.
sentences.zh: 他的名字不在选票上，因此，这其实与他无关。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Midterm elections may not matter because Trump is not the person people are voting for technically?
sentences.zh: 中期选举可能并不重要，因为从技术上讲，特朗普并不是人们投票的对象？

sentences.en: In terms of how he's looking at it.
sentences.zh: 就他的看法而言是这样的。

sentences.en: That doesn't mean that that's how his advisors are looking at it, but that has generally been his—
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着他的顾问们也是这么看的，但他的态度通常是——

sentences.en: Because he still is the president who has to deal with the repercussions of the midterMs.
sentences.zh: 因为他依然是那个不得不处理中期选举后果的总统。

sentences.en: Indeed, but he tends to look at things through a different prism.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，但他往往是通过一个不同的棱镜来看待事物。

sentences.en: It doesn't mean that he'll only look at it that way forever, but that has been how it is up until this point in terms of a lack of focus.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着他永远只用这种方式看待问题，但就缺乏关注度而言，迄今为止情况一直如此。

sentences.en: What is clear, Michael, in every single poll that we have had described to us in our reporting is that the war has damaged Trump's numbers universally.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我们在报道中听到的每一份民调都清楚地表明，战争已经普遍损害了特朗普的支持率。

sentences.en: And, again, it doesn't mean he won't come back from it, maybe, depending on how this ends.
sentences.zh: 当然，这并不意味着他不会东山再起，也许吧，这取决于这场战争如何收场。

sentences.en: But the longer it goes, Republicans who have been generally in lockstep with Trump because they've really been afraid of incurring his wrath
sentences.zh: 但时间拖得越久，那些原本因为害怕招致他的怒火而一直紧跟特朗普步伐的共和党人，

sentences.en: are going to face a choice about how closely to align with him in the fall.
sentences.zh: 将在秋季面临一个关于如何与他保持一致的抉择。

sentences.en: Jonathan, Maggie invoked you, which means in terms of debate stage rules, now it's your turn.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，玛姬点名提到了你，这意味着按照辩论台的规则，现在轮到你了。

sentences.en: But what I want to ask you is, is it actually true that the president really doesn't think of himself as being on the ballot?
sentences.zh: 但我想问你的是，总统真的认为自已不在选票上，这难道是真的吗？

sentences.en: Because I can remember a couple months back, the president goes, speaks in front of congressional Republicans,
sentences.zh: 因为我记得几个月前，总统去国会山对共和党人发表讲话，

sentences.en: and he says to them, you need to win these midterms because if you don't, I get impeached.
sentences.zh: 他对他们说，你们必须赢得这些中期选举，因为如果你们输了，我就会被弹劾。

sentences.en: There's no question he doesn't want to get impeached again.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，他绝不想再次被弹劾。

sentences.en: If Democrats control the House, right.
sentences.zh: 如果民主党控制了众议院的话，没错。

sentences.en: Does Donald Trump want Republicans to hold the House?
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普希望共和党人保住众议院吗？

sentences.en: Of course he does.
sentences.zh: 他当然希望。

sentences.en: But what Maggie's saying, which is actually a real source of frustration among some of his advisors, is he just doesn't actually care that much.
sentences.zh: 但玛姬所说的是，这实际上是他的某些顾问真正感到沮丧的根源，那就是他其实根本没那么在意。

sentences.en: Yes, he prefers that they win the midterms, but based on everything that we're being told by people who are around him,
sentences.zh: 是的，他更倾向于他们赢得中期选举，但根据身边的人告诉我们的一切，

sentences.en: it's his team that's very focused on the midterms and, you know, affordability, what can we do?
sentences.zh: 是他的团队非常关注中期选举，以及，你知道的，生活可负担性，我们能做些什么？

sentences.en: There's nothing Donald Trump would less rather talk about than affordability.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普最不愿意谈论的事情莫过于生活可负担性了。

sentences.en: Really, nothing.
sentences.zh: 真的，没有什么比这更不愿意谈的了。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Maybe healthcare policy.
sentences.zh: 也许医疗保健政策算一个吧。

sentences.en: But what Donald Trump is focused on in this term, what he has been focused on, is making himself a capital G great figure of history.
sentences.zh: 但唐纳德·特朗普在这一任期内所关注的，他一直专注于的事情，是将自己塑造为一个具有大写G的历史伟大人物。

sentences.en: Great man of history.
sentences.zh: 历史伟人。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: A great man of history.
sentences.zh: 历史伟人。

sentences.en: The amount of time he's spending on domestic politics pales in comparison to him taking really bold,
sentences.zh: 他花在内政上的时间，与他在外交政策上采取真正大胆、激进的举动相比，简直是小巫见大巫，

sentences.en: aggressive moves in foreign policy and also putting his physical imprint on the world, on Washington, D.C., designing monuments to himself, renaming institutions,
sentences.zh: 而且他还在世界上、在华盛顿特区留下自已的实体印记，设计自己的纪念碑，为机构更名，

sentences.en: ensuring that he achieves some level of immortality, building a grand ballroom, calling it the Donald J.
sentences.zh: 确保自己达到某种程度的不朽，建造一个宏伟的宴会厅，并将其命名为唐纳德·J·

sentences.en: Trump Institute of Peace.
sentences.zh: 特朗普和平研究所。

sentences.en: That's a huge part of his mindset in this second term.
sentences.zh: 这是他在第二任期思维模式中非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: None of these things are winning issues when it comes to swing voters and independent voters
sentences.zh: 当涉及到那些对特朗普极度失望的摇摆选民和独立选民时，这些事情没有一件是能够赢得选票的议题，

sentences.en: that have massively soured on Trump, but it's not really up high on his hierarchy of concerns.
sentences.zh: 但这并不在他关注层级的显要位置。

sentences.en: He's thinking at just a different level than a lot of his advisors.
sentences.zh: 他的思考层面与他的许多顾问有着本质的不同。

sentences.en: Which is to say, when you start to subscribe to the great man of history theory, then elections, they're temporary.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，当你开始认同历史伟人理论时，选举就变得微不足道了。

sentences.en: And they don't really mean all that much.
sentences.zh: 它们其实并没有那么大意义。

sentences.en: A midterm election next to regime change in Venezuela and what he's doing in Iran.
sentences.zh: 与委内瑞拉的政权更迭以及他在伊朗的所作所为相比，中期选举又算得了什么。

sentences.en: Well, it's even more than that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，甚至远不止于此。

sentences.en: Donald Trump has won his great victory.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普已经赢得了他伟大的胜利。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: His great victory was the 2024 election.
sentences.zh: 他最大的胜利是2024年的大选。

sentences.en: Against all reason and odds coming back from January 6th, he's not on the ballot anymore.
sentences.zh: 顶着所有的质疑和不可能，从1月6日的事件中卷土重来，但他现在不能再参选了。

sentences.en: You know, I talked to one of his advisors and they were saying, how much do you think he really deeply cares about the 2028 Republican at the top of the ticket
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我跟他的一个顾问聊过，他们当时在讨论，你觉得他到底有多在乎2028年共和党总统候选人提名

sentences.en: and what happens there?
sentences.zh: 以及到时候会发生什么？

sentences.en: The next presidential, right?
sentences.zh: 下一任总统，对吧？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, if that person loses, well, only Donald J.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果那个人输了，嗯，只有唐纳德·J·

sentences.en: Trump can win.
sentences.zh: 特朗普才能赢。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So, there's that.
sentences.zh: 所以，情况就是这样。

sentences.en: But there's another thing.
sentences.zh: 但还有另一件事。

sentences.en: He's changed the American presidency in very profound ways.
sentences.zh: 他对美国总统职位的改变非常深远。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: As we've discussed with you both and Charlie Savage, endlessly.
sentences.zh: 正如我们和你以及查理·萨维奇（Charlie Savage）无休止讨论过的那样。

sentences.en: Endlessly.
sentences.zh: 无休止地。

sentences.en: But his use of power here at home is like nothing we've seen in our lifetimes.
sentences.zh: 但他在国内动用权力的方式，是我们生平仅见。

sentences.en: So, again, when you come to his mindshare and things that he's thinking of, his team has to really pick their moments for when they show him polling or anything negative because
sentences.zh: 所以，再说说他的关注点和心事，他的团队在向他展示民调或任何负面消息时，真的得挑好时机，因为

sentences.en: he just, he kind of just doesn't want to hear it.
sentences.zh: 他就是，他基本上就是不想听这些。

sentences.en: These other things are just small ball compared to what he's doing.
sentences.zh: 与他正在做的事情相比，这些其他事情都只是小儿科。

sentences.en: Maggie, one potential counterpoint, but maybe you're about to tell me I shouldn't view it as a counterpoint, seems to be Trump firing cabinet members.
sentences.zh: 玛吉（Maggie），有一个潜在的反例，不过也许你正要告诉我，我不应该把它看作反例，那就是特朗普在撤换内阁成员。

sentences.en: Three, in the past, I think, month or so alone, which would in theory suggest that he does recognize that he has some domestic political probleMs.
sentences.zh: 光是过去一个月左右，我想就有三个，这理论上表明他确实意识到了自己面临一些国内政治问题。

sentences.en: Am I reading that wrong?
sentences.zh: 是我理解错了这事吗？

sentences.en: I think you might be overthinking that under a standard frame, Michael.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我觉得在常规框架下，你可能想得太多了。

sentences.en: A simpleton, you call me.
sentences.zh: 你管我叫单纯的人。

sentences.en: What I think, Michael, is number one, this is not a cabinet that was put together based on the idea of extensive resumes in the subject areas.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我的看法是，第一，这个内阁在组建时，并不是基于相关领域丰富履历的考量。

sentences.en: Loyalty was number one, two, three.
sentences.zh: 忠诚度是第一、第二、第三位。

sentences.en: Loyalty was number one, two, three.
sentences.zh: 忠诚度是第一、第二、第三位。

sentences.en: But loyalty doesn't necessarily translate to, I praise you so much, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 但忠诚并不一定转化为：总统先生，我太崇拜你了。

sentences.en: I think you're wonderful, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，我觉得你太棒了。

sentences.en: It's do what I want.
sentences.zh: 而是：按我说的做。

sentences.en: And so, in fact, I would argue that he is behaving like somebody who thinks that this changeover is probably going to happen anyway.
sentences.zh: 因此，实际上我认为他的行为举止就像是一个认为这种政权更迭无论如何都会发生的人。

sentences.en: He's kind of ambivalent about it in terms of control of the House, maybe the Senate.
sentences.zh: 在控制众议院、或许还有参议院方面，他对此有点模棱两可。

sentences.en: And so that only gives him six months to get done the things he cares about.
sentences.zh: 所以这只给他留下了六个月的时间来完成他在乎的事情。

sentences.en: What does he care about?
sentences.zh: 他在乎什么？

sentences.en: He cares about, and he's very open about it.
sentences.zh: 他在乎的事情，而且他对此毫不掩饰。

sentences.en: The Fed investigation, the investigation of the construction project at the Fed renovation, he doesn't like Jay Powell, as he has said repeatedly, the Fed chairman who he's trying
sentences.zh: 美联储的调查，美联储装修工程项目的调查，他不喜欢杰罗姆·鲍威尔（Jay Powell），正如他多次说过的那样，这位美联储主席他正试图

sentences.en: to replace right now.
sentences.zh: 在现在将其替换掉。

sentences.en: He was open with Pam Bondi, now the former attorney general, back in September, that she wasn't moving fast enough to prosecute certain people.
sentences.zh: 早在9月份，他就对现任前总检察长帕姆·邦迪（Pam Bondi）直言不讳，说她起诉某些人的速度不够快。

sentences.en: In that case, it was James Comey.
sentences.zh: 在那个案件中，那个人是詹姆斯·科米（James Comey）。

sentences.en: He has been talking to allies about how prosecutions can move quicker.
sentences.zh: 他一直在与盟友讨论如何加快起诉进程。

sentences.en: You are seeing Todd Blanche now work with-
sentences.zh: 你现在看到托德·布兰奇（Todd Blanche）在与——

sentences.en: This is the acting attorney general.
sentences.zh: 这就是代理总检察长。

sentences.en: These are people who the president believes are going to do what he wants.
sentences.zh: 这些人都是总统认为会按照他的意愿行事的人。

sentences.en: And what he wants is to see certain people indicted.
sentences.zh: 而他的意愿就是看到某些人被起诉。

sentences.en: He wants to see certain institutions discredited.
sentences.zh: 他希望看到某些机构信誉扫地。

sentences.en: That is what he is focused on.
sentences.zh: 这才是他关注的焦点。

sentences.en: In other words, the reason why he's replacing people in the cabinet is not because he's worried about the political appeal of them in the midterms,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他撤换内阁成员的原因，并不是担心他们在中期选举中的政治吸引力，

sentences.en: but because he may already accept that he might lose the House and might lose control of Congress,
sentences.zh: 而是因为他可能已经接受了自己可能会失去众议院、失去国会控制权的现实，

sentences.en: and therefore he needs to get a bunch of stuff done fast, including replacing cabinet members.
sentences.zh: 因此他需要迅速办成一大堆事情，包括更换内阁成员。

sentences.en: Obviously, the firing of the attorney general had nothing to do with the midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 很显然，撤换总检察长与中期选举的结果毫无关系。

sentences.en: We all know why he fired her.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道他为什么要解雇她。

sentences.en: He made it very clear to his advisors.
sentences.zh: 他向他的顾问们表达得非常清楚。

sentences.en: He was frustrated because the Department of Justice under Pam Bondi was not prosecuting his enemies quickly enough.
sentences.zh: 他感到沮丧，是因为在帕姆·邦迪领导下的司法部起诉他的政敌的速度不够快。

sentences.en: That has nothing to do with the results in any battleground state in the midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 这与任何摇摆州在中期选举中的结果都没有半点关系。

sentences.en: The other two cabinet secretaries who were fired were getting lots and lots of bad headlines for the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 另外两位被解雇的内阁部长给特朗普政府带来了大量负面新闻。

sentences.en: And, of course, he doesn't like that.
sentences.zh: 当然，他不喜欢这样。

sentences.en: And, again, I don't want to overstate what we've been saying.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我不想夸大我们刚才所说的话。

sentences.en: Donald Trump wants to hold the House in the midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普确实希望在中期选举中保住众议院。

sentences.en: Of course he does.
sentences.zh: 他当然想。

sentences.en: I'm just saying it's not at the top of his hierarchy of things that he's concerned about.
sentences.zh: 我只是说这并不是他最关心的核心事项。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Understandable.
sentences.zh: 可以理解。

sentences.en: You both keep returning to this idea that the president is very singularly focused on himself,
sentences.zh: 你们两个一直反复提到这样一个观点，即这位总统非常单一地专注于他自己，

sentences.en: on avenging himself, on finding his appropriate place in history, whether that's in Iran or here at home.
sentences.zh: 专注于为自己复仇，专注于在历史中找到他应有的位置，无论是涉及伊朗还是国内事务。

sentences.en: But quite clearly at the moment, that doesn't seem to be a viable position for the rest of the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 但在当下的明显局势下，对于共和党的其他成员来说，这似乎并不是一个可行的立场。

sentences.en: And I wonder how many of the leaders of the Republican Party are willing, they don't have a long history of doing it, of telling him that.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，有多少共和党领袖愿意——他们过去并没有这样做过的长久历史——把这话告诉他。

sentences.en: We're starting to see some ruptures in the seams in the Republican influencer.
sentences.zh: 我们开始在共和党意见领袖的阵营中看到一些裂痕。

sentences.en: We're just at this very interesting moment because the coalition that Trump assembled in 2024 was sort of a political miracle.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于这样一个非常有趣的时刻，因为特朗普在2024年拼凑起来的联盟简直是一个政治奇迹。

sentences.en: I mean, it was really an incredible coalition.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这真是一个令人难以置信的联盟。

sentences.en: People who just don't typically vote, young men, disaffected people coming together, independents.
sentences.zh: 那些通常不投票的人、年轻男性、心怀不满的人以及独立选民走到了一起。

sentences.en: You know, none of the real fights on the right were actually resolved in the Republican primaries in 2024.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，右翼内部真正的争端在2024年的共和党初选中根本没有得到解决。

sentences.en: The only thing that was resolved is we love Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 唯一解决的问题是：我们爱唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: A hundred percent, yes.
sentences.zh: 百分之百，是的。

sentences.en: So that's how you have a party which can contain people who absolutely despise each other, who have fundamental worldview differences,
sentences.zh: 所以这就是为什么这样一个政党能够容纳那些绝对鄙视彼此、世界观存在根本差异的人，

sentences.en: have all been sort of put under the umbrella of MAGA.
sentences.zh: 他们都被归入了MAGA的旗帜之下。

sentences.en: And because of Donald Trump as this figure of historic charisma and force of personality and an ability to rally a mass movement,
sentences.zh: 正因为唐纳德·特朗普具有这种历史性的个人魅力、个性力量以及凝聚群众运动的能力，

sentences.en: Trump papered over all of these disagreements and problems because he was Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普凭借他是唐纳德·特朗普这一点，掩盖了所有这些分歧和问题。

sentences.en: And now we're starting to see the first glimpses of what a post-Trump Republican Party looks like.
sentences.zh: 而现在，我们开始隐约看到后特朗普时代共和党的样子。

sentences.en: So what you then get is the disagreements, the fights, and all of these fractures.
sentences.zh: 所以随之而来的就是分歧、争斗和所有这些裂痕。

sentences.en: You get a bunch of people who voted for Donald Trump because he thought they were going to keep him out of foreign wars who are now in foreign wars, angrily disaffected.
sentences.zh: 你会发现有一群人投票给唐纳德·特朗普，是因为他们以为特朗普能让他们远离海外战争，而现在他们却身陷海外战争，愤怒而又不满。

sentences.en: And so now we're seeing the fight that never really happened in the 2024 Republican primaries, and we just don't know how it's going to play out.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们现在看到了2024年共和党初选中从未真正爆发过的争斗，而我们只是不知道这最终会如何收场。

sentences.en: And just to elucidate this fight, Marjorie Taylor Greene, former Georgia Republican, is now saying what Trump is doing and saying in Iran is insanity.
sentences.zh: 为了阐明这场争斗，前佐治亚州共和党人玛乔丽·泰勒·格林（Marjorie Taylor Greene）现在公开表示，特朗普在伊朗的所作所为简直是疯了。

sentences.en: Candace Owens, the far-right podcaster, calling Trump a genocidal lunatic.
sentences.zh: 极右翼播客主持人坎迪斯·欧文斯（Candace Owens）称特朗普为灭绝种族的疯子。

sentences.en: You have Tucker Carlson saying, I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 塔克·卡尔森（Tucker Carlson）则说：对不起。

sentences.en: I'm sorry for leading you to Trump.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉把你们带向了特朗普。

sentences.en: I regret it.
sentences.zh: 我对此感到后悔。

sentences.en: I feel implicated.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己也有责任。

sentences.en: You've got Alex Jones saying, Trump sounds like his brain's not doing too hot.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·琼斯（Alex Jones）甚至说：特朗普听起来脑子有点不太清醒了。

sentences.en: You know, he's still popular among Republicans, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他在共和党人中依然很受欢迎，对吧？

sentences.en: But he has lost meaningful support among Republicans.
sentences.zh: 但他在共和党人中已经失去了实质性的支持。

sentences.en: And where he's really lost support profoundly is among independents.
sentences.zh: 而且他真正痛失支持的地方是在独立选民当中。

sentences.en: So that coalition, that miraculous coalition that he pulled together, has unmistakably fractured.
sentences.zh: 所以那个联盟，那个他拼凑起来的奇迹般的联盟，已经无可辩驳地破裂了。

sentences.en: But I do think people are overstating the extent of bleeding from the Republican side.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为人们夸大了来自共和党阵营的失血程度。

sentences.en: And it's important to note that Trump has another two and a half years left of this term, and he does still remain the central figure of this party.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，特朗普的这个任期还有两年半时间，他依然是这个政党的核心人物。

sentences.en: And so Marco Rubio, J.D.
sentences.zh: 所以马可·鲁比奥（Marco Rubio）、J.D.

sentences.en: Vance.
sentences.zh: 万斯（Vance）。

sentences.en: Every congressional Republican.
sentences.zh: 国会中的每一位共和党人。

sentences.en: Every congressional Republican.
sentences.zh: 国会中的每一位共和党人。

sentences.en: Most of the Senate Republicans, influencers who have made their livings on the fact that Donald Trump is president, they are starting to see their interests diverge some from him,
sentences.zh: 大多数参议院共和党人，以及那些靠着唐纳德·特朗普当总统而谋生的意见领袖们，他们开始发现自己的利益与他产生了一些分歧，

sentences.en: whereas it had been in total alignment until now.
sentences.zh: 而在此之前，他们的利益是完全一致的。

sentences.en: But they can't really get away from him for another two and a half years.
sentences.zh: 但在接下来的两年半里，他们实际上摆脱不了他。

sentences.en: They are all stuck with him.
sentences.zh: 他们全都只能跟他绑在一起。

sentences.en: And if there is anything that we know about Donald Trump, not just during his political career, but over the last 50 years,
sentences.zh: 如果我们对唐纳德·特朗普有什么了解的话——不仅是在他的从政生涯中，而且在过去的50年里——

sentences.en: is that he is not someone who is going to enthusiastically or willingly or quietly see the spotlight to anybody else.
sentences.zh: 那就是他绝对不是那种会热情、自愿或安静地把聚光灯让给别人的人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Great men of history never leave the stage.
sentences.zh: 历史上的伟大人物从不退场。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay, well, Maggie and Jonathan, so great to have you back.
sentences.zh: 好的，玛吉和乔纳森，很高兴你们能再次做客。

sentences.en: Let's do it again soon.
sentences.zh: 我们不久后再次聚首吧。

sentences.en: Let's do it.
sentences.zh: 就这么办。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the Trump administration said it had loosened legal restrictions for medical marijuana, allowing it to be used for more research and more treatments.
sentences.zh: 周四，特朗普政府表示已放宽对医用大麻的法律限制，允许将其用于更多的研究和治疗。

sentences.en: The change treats FDA-approved and state-regulated medical marijuana less like heroin, which is heavily restricted, and more like ketamine.
sentences.zh: 这一改变对待经FDA批准和州政府监管的医用大麻的方式，不再像受到严厉限制的海洛因那样，而是更像氯胺酮（K粉）。

sentences.en: The change, however, has no impact on federal restrictions over marijuana's recreational use.
sentences.zh: 然而，这一改变并未对联邦关于大麻娱乐用途的限制产生任何影响。

sentences.en: And in the latest sign of how rapidly artificial intelligence is changing the workplace, Meta, the owner of Facebook and Instagram, said it plans to cut 8,000 workers,
sentences.zh: 作为人工智能以多快速度改变职场的最新迹象，Facebook和Instagram的母公司Meta表示，计划裁员8000人，

sentences.en: or about 10% of its staff.
sentences.zh: 约占其员工总数的10%。

sentences.en: The company's founder, Mark Zuckerberg, has said he expects much of the work now done in tech to eventually be overtaken by AI.
sentences.zh: 该公司创始人马克·扎克伯格曾表示，他预计目前由科技行业完成的大部分工作最终将被人工智能取代。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了大批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时甚至令人惊心动魄的争斗中。
